Nina Park: Heads-up — planning the EU edge routing change tonight, 23:00 UTC. Goal: shift 20% traffic to eu-west-new pool for 45m canary, then 100% if green. Who's on deploy + smoke?
Samir Rao: I can run the rollout and monitor metrics. Will be oncall.
Olivia Chen: I'll own smoke checks (latency, 5xxs, error budget panels). Can do 23:00–23:50 window.
Jesse: I can stand by for rollback and DNS flips. What's TTL plan?
Nina Park: TTL -> 30s at 22:45 UTC (preflight). We'll keep health check interval at 15s.
Samir Rao: Confirming sequence: 1) reduce TTL 2) apply route-policy 20% canary 3) observe 45m 4) ramp to 100% if ok. Rollback policy: immediate rollback to previous policy if P50 latency > baseline+35ms or >0.5% 5xx spike for 5m.
Olivia Chen: I'll smoke with these quick checks: `curl -sS https://eu.example.com/healthz` expecting `{"ok":true}`, run `dig +short eu.example.com` to verify IPs, and spot-check token latency via query load from perf-test.
Jesse: For rollback, I'll prepare the DNS change job and a small runbook: `./scripts/dns-swap --zone eu --from-new --to-old --ttl 30`. If we need instant rollback, we also have routing-policy revert `rbctl revert --policy edge-eu-v2`.
release-bot: Scheduled deploy: eu-edge-routing v2 at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z by Samir Rao. CI: green.
qa-bot: Canary checks: synthetic traffic steady-state baseline captured. Alert thresholds pre-created (latency, error-rate, infra-error).
Nina Park: FYI — we'll mute non-critical alerts for the 45m canary to avoid noise. Keep page-level alerts active.
Samir Rao: I'll post live timestamps in this thread every 15m during the canary.
Olivia Chen: Quick question — any customers pinned to eu-old pool that need manual contact?
Jesse: Two internal partners (analytics team) have pinned traffic for maintenance; I pinged them already to expect a 1h window.
Nina Park: Preflight checklist for 22:30: reduce TTL, confirm synthetic runs green, confirm rollback artifacts uploaded, confirm oncall in channel. Who can ACK preflight at 22:40?
Samir Rao: ACK at 22:40.
Olivia Chen: ACK.
Jesse: ACK and ready to run rollback.
Nina Park: Great — if anything looks off, call for rollback early. Post results here. :thumbsup:
